author: LegalEagle
description:
Imagine failing the bar exam because someone allegedly took your points and gave them to another test taker 📝

In Arkansas, officials uncovered what they describe as a large-scale scheme by Nancie Givens, the former executive director of the Office of Professional Programs, to manually alter bar exam scores. People who should have passed allegedly failed, and people who should have failed allegedly passed, affecting more than 60 examinees.

On her way out, Givens also allegedly deleted more than 11,000 internal files. The alleged tampering affected bar exams administered between July 2020 and July 2025.

She has been charged with 65 felony counts of tampering with public records, and more charges may follow.

Follow us for updates as this case develops!

title: She Allegedly Rigged Arkansas Bar Exam Scores for 5 Years
